info.title: Releases API
info.description:
REST API for the Releases changelog registry — orgs, products, sources, releases, and search.

**Links:** [releases.sh](https://releases.sh) · [Narrative docs](https://releases.sh/docs/api/rest) · [Errors](https://releases.sh/docs/api/errors) · [MCP server](https://releases.sh/docs/api/mcp)

code.description: Stable, specific machine code (e.g. `not_found`, `rate_limited`). Never reworded once shipped, but open-ended — branch defensively on codes you don't recognize.

type.description: Coarse category from a fixed set; determines the HTTP status. Safe to switch on.

message.description: Human-readable explanation. May change; do not parse.

details.description: Optional structured context carried by select codes (e.g. `database_not_initialized`).

ErrorEnvelope.description: Standardized error response — every non-2xx response uses this shape. Switch on `error.type` (fixed set → HTTP status) or match `error.code` (specific, stable). See https://releases.sh/docs/api/errors.

bearerAuth.description: Machine/operator tokens use the relk_ prefix; self-serve read-only user keys use relu_; Sign in with Releases supplies an OAuth access token. Required scope depends on the endpoint.

tags.name: Sources
tags.description: Changelog sources owned by an org.

tags.name: Products
tags.description: Optional grouping layer between orgs and sources.

tags.name: Related
tags.description: Vectorize-backed similarity rails for releases and sources.

tags.name: Collections
tags.description: Curated, named org playlists independent of category.

tags.name: Account
tags.description: The signed-in caller: follows, the personalized feed, publish tokens, and semantic alerts. Session cookie or user Bearer (`relu_` / OAuth JWT).

tags.name: Listing
tags.description: Self-serve listing: manifest validation, activation, and ownership claims.

get.summary: Public registry rollup with per-source activity
get.description: Returns a hybrid payload: the flat back-compat `orgs/sources/releases/products` counts (used by the web homepage banner) merged with the richer `StatsSummary` shape — `period`, `totals`, `sourceHealth`, `sourceActivity`, and the 20 most recent fetch-log entries. Counts use `*_active` / `*_visible` views, so soft-deleted and hidden rows are excluded.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Lookback window for `releasesInPeriod`, `sourceHealth.stale/upToDate`, and `sourceActivity.recentReleases`. Defaults to 30.

get.description: Returns the single active site notice, or `{ notice: null }` when none is published. An admin Bearer additionally sees a stored-but-inactive (draft) notice.

Paginated list of orgs with 30-day release sparklines. Supports `?q=` substring search on name/slug. Orgs that have no indexed releases yet are hidden by default; pass `?includeEmpty=true` to opt in. The response always carries `meta.emptyOrgCount` so a UI toggle can show how many are hidden without a second round-trip.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match on name or slug.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Filter to a single canonical category slug (e.g. `ai`, `devops`). Invalid values are ignored (unfiltered). `meta.emptyOrgCount` is scoped to the same filter.

parameters.name: includeEmpty
parameters.description: Include orgs that have zero indexed releases. Default `false` — empty orgs are stubs from in-flight discovery or broken parsers and surface as noise on the public catalog.

parameters.name: featured
parameters.description: Filter to editorially featured orgs only (home-page rail). Default unfiltered.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Filter to orgs with a linked account on this platform (e.g. `github`, `x`). Matched case-insensitively. `meta.emptyOrgCount` is scoped to the same filter.

parameters.name: trackingRequested
parameters.description: Admin-only. Pass `1` to restrict to orgs that have stamped `trackingRequestedAt` (the self-serve listing owner-demand signal, #1947), ordered most-recent-first. Items still conform to `OrgListItemSchema` (same envelope as the public list) but carry the additive `trackingRequestedAt` field and zeroed stats — these are self-serve stub orgs with no processed sources yet. Requires admin bearer auth — a non-admin caller gets a 403, the param is never silently ignored.

get.description: Resolves by slug, `org_…` ID, primary domain, or domain alias. Authenticated callers also receive the org playbook (private; CDN cache opt-out).

404.description: Organization not found

get.summary: Export the org as a releases.json manifest
get.description: Reconstructs an owner-declared `releases.json` v2 domain manifest from the org's live products + sources — the inverse of the well-known materializer. Each source becomes a release locator (github/appstore/feed/url, mirroring fetch routing), nested under its product or top-level; the primary source is marked `canonical`. Intended as an editable baseline an owner can host at `/.well-known/releases.json`; the output validates against the v2 schema and round-trips through the fill-if-empty well-known sweep for enrichment. Hidden/soft-deleted entities are excluded.

404.description: Organization not found

get.description: Returns the curated collections that include this organization — either because the org itself is a member, or because one of its products is a member (e.g. a `coding-agents` collection that pins Claude Code surfaces on the Anthropic org page). Deduplicated and ordered alphabetically by collection name. Each item includes `memberCount` (visible public orgs + products, matching `GET /v1/collections`). Use `GET /v1/collections/:slug` for the full collection detail.

404.description: Organization not found

get.description: Returns the org's registered accounts (GitHub, Twitter, LinkedIn, etc.) as a paginated list. Pass `?platform=<name>` to fetch a single account by platform — returns the account object or `null` when not set. When the org holds multiple accounts for the platform, single-mode returns the oldest-linked one deterministically; use the full list (omit `?platform`) to retrieve them all. The 200 schema is a union of the paginated list (default) or a single `OrgAccountItem`/`null` (single-mode) — the OSS CLI depends on the single-row return shape.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: When provided, returns a single `OrgAccountItem` for the given platform (or `null`). When absent, returns the full paginated list.

200.description: Paginated org accounts (default), or a single `OrgAccountItem`/`null` when `?platform=` is supplied

404.description: Organization not found

get.description: Returns the org's tag names as a paginated list, sorted alphabetically. Returns an empty list (not 404) when the org has no tags.

404.description: Organization not found

get.description: Returns the org's combined release feed across all sources, newest-first. Cursor-paginated — pass `nextCursor` from the previous response as `?cursor=` on the next request. Accepts `?source_type=`, `?kind=`, `?include_coverage=true`, `?include_prereleases=true`, and `?q=` full-text search.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response's `pagination.nextCursor`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max releases to return. Defaults to 20, capped at 100.

parameters.name: source_type
parameters.description: Filter by source type (e.g. `github`, `feed`, `scrape`).

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Filter by resolved entity kind (source.kind ?? product.kind). One of: platform, sdk, mobile, desktop, docs, integration, tool.

parameters.name: product
parameters.description: Restrict the feed to one product (slug or `prod_…` id, scoped to this org). Unknown product → 404.

parameters.name: include_coverage
parameters.description: When true, include coverage-side rows (hidden by default).

parameters.name: include_prereleases
parameters.description: When true, include pre-release entries.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Full-text search query applied to release title and content.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Keep only releases published at or after this bound. Accepts an ISO date/datetime or relative shorthand (`90d`, `4w`, `6m`, `2y`). Filters `published_at`; undated releases are dropped.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Keep only releases published at or before this bound. Same input formats as `since`; a bare date (`2026-06-25`) includes that whole UTC day.

parameters.name: minImportance
parameters.description: Only include releases with AI-scored `importance` >= this value (1–5). Releases with no score (`null`) are excluded when set.

404.description: Organization not found

get.description: Returns the paginated `{items, pagination}` envelope. Filter by `?orgId=` to scope to one org. Filter by `?kind=` to narrow to a specific entity kind.

parameters.name: orgId
parameters.description: Scope results to one organization by ID.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Filter by entity kind. Direct match on the row's own kind — no inheritance from a parent. One of: platform, sdk, mobile, desktop, docs, integration, tool.

get.description: Org-scoped product list — the canonical nested form of `GET /products?orgId=`. `:slug` accepts an org slug or `org_…` id. Returns the paginated `{items, pagination}` envelope. Filter by `?kind=` to narrow to a specific entity kind (direct match on the product's own kind).

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Organization slug or `org_…` id.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Filter by entity kind. Direct match on the row's own kind — no inheritance from a parent. One of: platform, sdk, mobile, desktop, docs, integration, tool.

404.description: Organization not found

get.description: Resolves by slug or `prod_…` ID on the bare path, or by org-scoped slug pair. Returns the product row plus its sources, tags, and domain aliases.

200.description: Product detail with sources, tags, and aliases

400.description: Bare slug supplied on `/products/:identifier` (#698 — use the org-scoped path or `/v1/lookups/product-by-slug`)

404.description: Product not found

get.description: Resolves by slug or `prod_…` ID on the bare path, or by org-scoped slug pair. Returns the product row plus its sources, tags, and domain aliases.

200.description: Product detail with sources, tags, and aliases

400.description: Bare slug supplied on `/products/:identifier` (#698 — use the org-scoped path or `/v1/lookups/product-by-slug`)

404.description: Product not found

get.description: Returns the product's tag names sorted alphabetically. Empty array when the product has no tags. Only a typed `prod_…` ID resolves on this path; bare slugs return 400 (#698). Slug-only callers should first resolve via `GET /v1/lookups/product-by-slug?slug=…` and re-hit this endpoint with the returned `productId`.

404.description: Product not found

get.summary: Resolve an org-scoped slug to a product or source
get.description: Product-first: returns `{ kind: "product", product }` when a product owns the slug, else `{ kind: "source", source }` for a source, else 404. One round trip for the bare `/[org]/[slug]` web route (#1190).

parameters.name: org
parameters.description: Organization slug or `org_…` ID.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Org-scoped product or source slug to resolve (product-first).

404.description: Neither a product nor a source matched

get.description: Returns the curated collections that pin this product, ordered alphabetically by collection name. Mirrors `GET /v1/orgs/:slug/collections` so the web 'Featured in' sidebar renders identically at the org and product levels — a `coding-agents` collection that pins Claude Code surfaces on the Claude Code product page. Each item includes `memberCount` (visible public orgs + products).

404.description: Product not found

get.description: Returns the curated collections that pin this product, ordered alphabetically by collection name. Mirrors `GET /v1/orgs/:slug/collections` so the web 'Featured in' sidebar renders identically at the org and product levels — a `coding-agents` collection that pins Claude Code surfaces on the Claude Code product page. Each item includes `memberCount` (visible public orgs + products).

404.description: Product not found

get.description: Cacheable cross-source feed ordered by `(publishedAt DESC, fetchedAt DESC, id DESC)`. `?source=` and `?org=` are mutually exclusive scopes. `?exclude=` strips releases by source type — comma-separated values from `github,scrape,feed,agent`. By default, coverage-side rows (releases that roll up into a canonical release) are hidden; pass `?include_coverage=true` to include them. Prereleases (canaries / alphas / betas / RCs) are also hidden by default — pass `?include_prereleases=true` to surface them, matching the source-feed and MCP defaults. The unfiltered homepage shape is served through KV (`X-Cache: HIT|MISS`); filtered requests bypass cache (`X-Cache: BYPASS`).

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of releases to return. Clamped to `[1, 100]`.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Scope to a single source by typed ID (`src_…`) or slug. Mutually exclusive with `org`.

parameters.name: org
parameters.description: Scope to an org's sources by typed ID (`org_…`) or slug. Mutually exclusive with `source`.

parameters.name: include_coverage
parameters.description: Include coverage-side rows that normally roll up into a canonical release.

parameters.name: include_prereleases
parameters.description: Include prereleases (canaries / alphas / betas / RCs). Hidden by default to match the source-feed and MCP defaults.

parameters.name: exclude
parameters.description: Comma-separated source types to exclude. Allowed: `github`, `scrape`, `feed`, `agent`.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Keep only releases published at or after this bound. Accepts an ISO date/datetime or relative shorthand (`90d`, `4w`, `6m`, `2y`). Filters `published_at`; undated releases are dropped. Windowed requests bypass the KV cache (`X-Cache: BYPASS`).

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Keep only releases published at or before this bound. Same input formats as `since`; a bare date (`2026-06-25`) includes that whole UTC day.

parameters.name: minImportance
parameters.description: Only include releases with AI-scored `importance` >= this value (1–5). Releases with no score (`null`) are excluded when set. Filtered requests bypass the KV cache (`X-Cache: BYPASS`).

400.description: Invalid `exclude` value, unparseable `since`/`until`, invalid `minImportance`, or `source` and `org` both supplied

404.description: Source or org not found

get.description: Returns the role the given release plays in a coverage cluster. `standalone` means it is not in any cluster; `coverage` means it rolls up into `canonical`; `canonical` means it is the canonical row and `covers` enumerates the rollup-side releases.

Returns a bare array by default; pass `?envelope=true` for the paginated `{items, pagination}` shape. Filter by `?orgId=`, `?orgSlug=`, `?slug=` (exact source slug — one row per org that has a source with this slug, for detecting an ambiguous bare slug across orgs; distinct from the `?q=` substring search), `?productSlug=`, `?type=`, `?has_feed=`, `?stale=`, `?category=`, `?kind=`, `?independent=true`, `?hasChangelog=false` (sources with no tracked CHANGELOG file), `?minRels30d=N` (sources with at least N visible releases in the last 30 days). Free-text search via `?q=`.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Filter by entity kind. Direct match on the row's own kind — no inheritance from the parent product. One of: platform, sdk, mobile, desktop, docs, integration, tool.

post.summary: Publish a batch of releases
post.description: Inserts or updates releases for one source, identified by slug or `src_…` ID on the bare path, or by the org-scoped slug pair. Releases are matched on `url`: a new URL inserts, a known URL fills empty fields, or, with `mode: "upsert-content"`, overwrites content and media. Re-posting the same batch is safe. Requires a `write` token, or a publish token bound to this source. A source's first write with its owner's publish token marks it push-fed, so it is no longer polled.

version.description: Placeholder versions such as `<UNKNOWN>` or `n/a` are stripped.

url.description: Canonical permalink. Re-posting the same URL updates that release.

media.description: JSON-encoded array of `{ type, url, alt? }` media items.

200.description: Batch result: inserted count, the source's new release total, and the new IDs

400.description: `releases` is not an array, or `mode` is not `upsert-content`

403.description: Token lacks write scope, or the publish token is bound to another source

404.description: Source not found

Requires a `write` token, or a publish token bound to this source. A source's first write with its owner's publish token marks it push-fed, so it is no longer polled.

get.description: Cursor-paginated release feed scoped to one source. Supports inline FTS filter via `?q=`, prerelease toggle (`?include_prereleases=`), and coverage flag (`?include_coverage=`). Cursor shape matches `/v1/orgs/:slug/releases`.

404.description: Source not found

get.description: Returns the source's tracked CHANGELOG.md (or the file selected by `?path=`), sliced by characters (`?offset=`, `?limit=`) or by a cl100k_base token budget (`?tokens=`). Page with `nextOffset`. Always includes the full `files` index so clients can render a file picker.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Repo path of the file to return, from `files[].path`. Defaults to the root CHANGELOG.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Slice length in characters.

parameters.name: tokens
parameters.description: Slice to this many cl100k_base tokens instead of `limit` characters.

404.description: Source or changelog file not found

get.description: Returns the source's tracked CHANGELOG.md (or the file selected by `?path=`), sliced by characters (`?offset=`, `?limit=`) or by a cl100k_base token budget (`?tokens=`). Page with `nextOffset`. Always includes the full `files` index so clients can render a file picker.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Repo path of the file to return, from `files[].path`. Defaults to the root CHANGELOG.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Slice length in characters.

parameters.name: tokens
parameters.description: Slice to this many cl100k_base tokens instead of `limit` characters.

404.description: Source or changelog file not found

get.description: Resolves by slug or `src_…` ID on the bare path, or by org-scoped slug pair. Cursor-paginated `releases` array (`?cursor=` opaque cursor from a prior response's `pagination.nextCursor`, `?limit=` capped at 100); `?include_coverage=true` exposes coverage rows; `?include_prereleases=true` includes pre-release entries.

404.description: Source not found

get.description: Resolves by slug or `src_…` ID on the bare path, or by org-scoped slug pair. Cursor-paginated `releases` array (`?cursor=` opaque cursor from a prior response's `pagination.nextCursor`, `?limit=` capped at 100); `?include_coverage=true` exposes coverage rows; `?include_prereleases=true` includes pre-release entries.

404.description: Source not found

get.description: Cursor-paginated release feed scoped to one source. Supports inline FTS filter via `?q=`, prerelease toggle (`?include_prereleases=`), and coverage flag (`?include_coverage=`). Cursor shape matches `/v1/orgs/:slug/releases`.

404.description: Source not found

get.description: Returns a single release by its typed `rel_…` ID. Suppressed and coverage-side rows are excluded via the `releases_visible` view — they return 404. The `content` field has CDN-origin media URLs rewritten in-place; the `media` array is parsed from the raw D1 JSON. Accepts `Accept: text/markdown` to receive the release formatted as Markdown. Accepts the friendly `rel_…-<slug>` URL segment form — the trailing slug is ignored for lookup. The response includes `webUrl`, the canonical releases.sh detail-page URL (Zendesk-style: ID + current title slug).

404.description: Release not found (or suppressed / coverage-only)

get.summary: Unified search across orgs, catalog, collections, releases, and chunks
get.description:
Returns orgs, catalog entries (products + standalone sources folded together), curated collections, release hits, and — on hybrid/semantic modes — CHANGELOG.md chunk hits in a single response.

Entity sections (orgs/catalog) match at word boundaries — including camelCase transitions ("ai" matches OpenAI but not Em·ai·l) — and never via a domain TLD ("ai" does not match coderabbit.ai). Hits order by match quality: exact name/slug, then name prefix, then name word, then slug/domain/URL, then org category.

`mode` selects the release-retrieval strategy: `lexical` (FTS5), `semantic` (vector-only), or `hybrid` (RRF fusion of FTS5 + vector; default). The handler echoes back the mode actually used, including `degraded: true` when a hybrid request fell back to lexical because Vectorize is unavailable.

`?domain=` narrows the entire result set to one org (matched against `organizations.domain` and `domain_aliases.domain`). Invalid hostnames return 400; unknown hostnames return an empty envelope with `domainStatus: "not_found"` (distinct from "matched but no hits").

`?category=` and `?collection=` scope orgs, catalog, and release hits to an org set — a fixed category slug (unknown → 400) or a curated collection's members (unknown → empty envelope with `collectionStatus: "not_found"`). Both compose with every other filter.

When the query parses as a GitHub coordinate (`org/repo` or `github:org/repo`) and no orgs/catalog matched, the handler runs an on-demand lookup and embeds the result on `lookup`. Coordinate-shaped queries are not suppressed by tangential release/chunk hits.

Collections surface via two paths: a direct match on the collection's name/description (lexical in every mode, plus a vector match in hybrid/semantic mode — vector hits below the relevance floor are dropped so off-topic queries return no collections) and a member rollup that includes every collection containing one of the matched orgs. Each row carries a `via` discriminator (`"direct"` vs `"member"`); `matchedOrgSlugs` on member rows names the result-set orgs that triggered the rollup so a UI can render an "includes X" hint.

Content negotiation: `Accept: text/markdown` returns a Markdown-rendered version of the same payload.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query. Required.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Per-section result cap. Each of orgs/catalog/releases respects this independently.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Release-list offset (lexical mode only).

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Release-retrieval strategy.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Narrow results to the org owning this domain.

parameters.name: org
parameters.description: Narrow results to one org by slug or `org_…` id — the same scope as `domain`, for callers that already know the org. Unknown orgs return an empty envelope with `orgStatus: "not_found"`. Pass either `org` or `domain`, not both (400).

parameters.name: product
parameters.description: Narrow release and catalog hits to a specific product's sources. Accepts a `prod_…` typed ID or an `orgSlug/productSlug` coordinate (e.g. `vercel/next-js`). Bare slugs (no `/` prefix) are rejected as ambiguous. Unknown products return an empty envelope with `productStatus: "not_found"`. Composes with `domain`, `kind`, `since`, and `until`.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Narrow orgs, catalog, and release hits to organizations in this category (the slugs `GET /v1/categories` lists; curator aliases resolve to canonical). Unknown values are rejected with 400. The response echoes the resolved slug as `category` with `categoryStatus: "matched"`. Composes with every other filter.

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: Narrow orgs, catalog, and release hits to the member organizations of this curated collection (by slug, e.g. `coding-agents`). Unknown slugs return an empty envelope with `collectionStatus: "not_found"` (mirrors `domain`). Composes with every other filter.

parameters.name: include_coverage
parameters.description: Include coverage-side rows that normally roll up into a canonical release.

parameters.name: include_content
parameters.description: Include full markdown `content` on each release hit. Default false — hits ship `summary` + `media` only (list/card surfaces). Use `GET /v1/releases/:id` for the full body when not opted in.

parameters.name: include_empty
parameters.description: Include orgs with zero indexed releases in the `orgs` section. Default false — empty orgs are stubs and surface as noise. `?domain=` short-circuits this and always returns the resolved org.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Filter to a specific source/product kind. Release hits resolve through `source.kind ?? product.kind`; catalog hits filter on the row's own kind. The orgs and collections sections are unaffected; changelog chunk hits are unaffected.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Keep only release hits published at or after this bound. Accepts an ISO date/datetime or relative shorthand (`90d`, `4w`, `6m`, `2y`). Filters `published_at`; releases with no date are dropped. The orgs/catalog/collections sections are unaffected.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Keep only release hits published at or before this bound. Same input formats as `since`; a bare date (`2026-06-25`) includes that whole UTC day. Filters `published_at`; releases with no date are dropped.

200.description: Unified search response. JSON by default; Markdown when `Accept: text/markdown` is sent.

400.description: Missing `q`, invalid `domain` hostname, `org` and `domain` both supplied, unknown `kind` or `category` value, or unparseable `since`/`until`

get.summary: Releases semantically similar to an anchor release
get.description:
Pulls the anchor's vector from the `RELEASES_INDEX` Vectorize index via `getByIds`, then runs a follow-up `query` with that vector. The anchor itself is always excluded from results. `scope=org` filters by the anchor's org id (Vectorize metadata filter on `org_id`); `scope=global` (default) is unscoped.

**Degrades gracefully:** when the binding is missing, the anchor isn't embedded yet, or Vectorize errors, the response is `{ degraded: true, degradedReason, items: [] }` with HTTP 200 — callers render nothing in that case. `degradedReason` is human-readable and not stable.

**Ranking:** `topK` is over-fetched (`min(max(limit * 10, 50), 100)`), then candidates are ranked server-side by `cosine × recency × contentWeight` and sliced to `limit`. Content-free releases (empty bodies, boilerplate "no changes" notes) are dropped entirely; short-but-real releases are down-weighted; recency uses a 45-day half-life. Items are returned already in display order.

parameters.name: release
parameters.description: Anchor release id (`rel_…`).

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Restrict candidates to the anchor's org, or run unscoped.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max neighbors to return. Clamped to 1–25.

parameters.name: excludeOrg
parameters.description: Org slug to drop from results before slicing. Used by the global rail to avoid overlap with an org-scoped rail rendered alongside it.

404.description: No release matches the supplied id.

get.summary: Sources semantically similar to an anchor source
get.description:
Pulls the anchor source's vector from the polymorphic `ENTITIES_INDEX` (orgs + products + sources) via `getByIds`, then runs `query` restricted to `type=source` so the candidate pool isn't wasted on parent orgs/products that would be filtered out post-hydration anyway. `scope=org` adds an `org_id` filter; `scope=global` (default) keeps the source filter only.

**Degrades gracefully** the same way `/v1/related/releases` does — missing binding, unembedded anchor, or query error returns `{ degraded: true, degradedReason, items: [] }` with HTTP 200.

Each surviving row carries its source basics plus an org rollup and a recent-release window-function stat block (`releaseCount`, `latestDate`, `latestTitle`, `latestVersion`, `recentCount`) so a rail card can render without follow-up requests.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Anchor source id (`src_…`) or slug.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Restrict candidates to the anchor's org, or run unscoped.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max neighbors to return. Clamped to 1–25.

404.description: No source matches the supplied identifier.

post.summary: On-demand GitHub source materialization
post.description:
Resolves a GitHub `org/repo` coordinate to a registry source. Idempotent — if the source already exists, returns it with `status: "existing"`; otherwise probes GitHub, inserts a hidden `on_demand` source row (and a new `on_demand` org when no curated org claims the segment), and ingests up to 100 releases.

Negative results (`not_found`, `empty`) are cached in KV (24h and 6h respectively) so repeat probes don't re-hit GitHub. `deferred` outcomes (rate-limit, 5xx) are not cached and let the next cron pass retry.

Body requires `provider: "github"` — other providers are explicitly rejected, not silently accepted. Coordinate must match `{org}/{repo}` (case-insensitive; URLs are deduped via `LOWER(sources.url)`).

get.description:
Given a `package` and a `from`/`to` version, returns the ordered release entries in the half-open range `(from, to]` — `from` exclusive (you have it), `to` inclusive — with summaries, breaking-change verdicts (#1696), and migration notes. One call instead of N changelog pages.

Reads already-ingested releases only (no live fetch). Resolution is read-only: an exact catalog source-slug match, then a non-materializing GitHub `owner/repo` coordinate match. An unresolvable package returns `status: "unknown"` with HTTP 200 — a valid answer, not an error; npm/PyPI names absent from the catalog resolve to `unknown` until the name→source map (#1345) lands. Wide ranges are truncated to a token budget (newest entries kept), flagged via `truncated`.

parameters.name: package
parameters.description: Package identifier — a catalog source slug or a GitHub "owner/repo" coordinate.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Version you're upgrading FROM (exclusive).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Version you're upgrading TO (inclusive).

parameters.name: ecosystem
parameters.description: Optional resolution hint. `github` enables the coordinate match for a bare owner/repo.

200.description: Upgrade range (resolved or unknown — both are 200)

get.description: Returns whether the self-serve listing lane and self-serve promotion are currently enabled. Public and anonymous; always reachable even when either kill switch is off (so clients can hide CTAs rather than offer a button that 404s).

post.summary: Validate a domain's releases.json and preview its listing
post.description: Fetches https://{domain}/.well-known/releases.json live (HTTPS-only, 64KB, 5s), validates it against the v2 manifest schema, and returns a preview: identity, products, and per-locator classification, plus whether the domain is already listed. Public and anonymous; rate limited.

200.description: Manifest validation result and listing preview

404.description: Lane disabled

post.summary: Activate an instant stub listing for an unlisted domain
post.description: Re-validates https://{domain}/.well-known/releases.json server-side, then creates a stub org (basis: declared) for an unlisted domain. Already-stub domains take no write except an optional tracking-request stamp; tracked domains 409 with the org pointer. Public and anonymous; rate limited per IP and per domain.

404.description: Lane disabled

post.summary: Start (or fetch) an ownership claim on a listed domain
post.description: Signed-in only. Mints a pending claim with a well-known-token + DNS-TXT proof pair for a stub or tracked domain; idempotent once verified. 404s an unlisted domain.

404.description: Lane disabled, or the domain is not listed

post.summary: Check the proof for a pending ownership claim
post.description: Signed-in only, and the claim must belong to the caller (404 otherwise — no existence oracle). Checks the well-known token file and the DNS TXT record; either passes. Fails closed on any ambiguous response. 200 whether or not it verifies.

200.description: Verification result (verified may be true or false)

404.description: No such claim for this caller

get.summary: List the caller's own ownership claims
get.description: Signed-in only. Lazily flips overdue pending claims to expired on read. Pending claims include the token + proof instructions; verified/expired do not.

404.description: Lane disabled

delete.summary: Release one of your ownership claims
delete.description: Signed-in only, and the claim must belong to the caller (404 otherwise). Ends a pending or verified claim: the row is kept as `revoked`. Publish tokens that relied on it stop working on their next request. Idempotent; an already-expired claim is returned unchanged. You can start a new claim later.

404.description: Lane disabled, or no such claim for this caller

post.summary: Self-serve promotion of a claimed stub org to tracked
post.description: Signed-in only, and the caller must hold a verified claim on the resolved org (403 otherwise). Materializes stored release locators into sources — tier-1 (feed/github/appstore) go live, tier-2 (bare url/file) land paused for curator review — and flips the org to tracked. Idempotent: an already-tracked org is a no-op success. Gated behind a dedicated kill switch (creates live fetching sources).

403.description: No verified claim on this domain

404.description: Lane or promotion flag disabled, or the domain is not listed

409.description: Promotion already in progress for this org
